name: Top Secret Matsuri on gold start
author: ToTheMoon321

notes: Send 2 to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and 3 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. One Vill builds @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on Gold. @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@

Once vills mine 30 gold, pull and help finish @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@. Once finished, use 130 gold to buy wood and queue first@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@. Send Matsuri vills to food after for one dropoff. Then back to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Continue @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@. Once 130 gold, buy another 100 wood at @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ and queue second@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@.
After first @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ finished, send wood vills to @resource/sheep.webp@
